sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx microbolometer, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 7-14 um, NETD <40 mK; optical: 1/1.9in Sony CMOS 2MP (1944x1092)
features: bi-spectrum thermal + visible pan and tilt (640x512 thermal + 2MP 30x visible)
thermal lens 19 or 25 mm (athermalized, focus-free); visible 30x optical zoom (6-180 mm)
pan 0 to 360 endless, tilt -90 to +90, 300 presets
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C (low), 0 to 550 C (high), accuracy Max (+/-2 C, +/-2%)
spot/line/area temperature measurement (12 rules per preset)
2/2 alarm in/out, RS-485, CVBS video output
release_notes: Ultra-series thermal network mobile hybrid pan-and-tilt camera pairing a 640x512 uncooled VOx thermal channel with a 2MP 30x-zoom Starlight visible channel; supports temperature measurement to 550 C, fire detection, and an integrated wiper on a wide-voltage 9-36 VDC platform.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels; PTZ via ONVIF.
